scope: Stationary ALOHA 1 follower mathematical, physical, and official-source closure research

central_finding.statement: The current blockers mix three different categories: quantities exactly derivable from CAD/schema/control source, numerical verification budgets derivable offline, and physical material/thermal quantities that cannot be inferred from geometry.
derivable_now: ideal virtual-work mapping from motor torque to symmetric finger normal force
task-local collider and solver convergence test definitions
not_derivable_from_cad: loaded linkage efficiency and internal friction
static and dynamic friction of the exact finger-pad and Bottle500 surface pair
restitution of the exact material pair

official_runtime_evidence.behavior: reboots the gripper and sets it to current_based_position before torque-on

current_limit_evidence.scope: configuration default if no later override applies

runtime_control_contract_correction.interpretation: There is no single evidence-backed current limit without naming the exact ALOHA pipeline. Static modes.yaml is not the final runtime control state.

momentary_current_limit_estimates.torque_estimation_basis: linearized 12 V stall ratio 4.1 Nm / 2.3 A
linearized 12 V stall ratio 4.1 Nm / 2.3 A

strict_boundary: These are momentary stall-linearized ideal upper estimates, not continuous grip-force claims.
The derivation omits linkage efficiency, internal friction, contact-normal misalignment, controller dynamics, voltage variation, and thermal derating.
The low ideal mu_min values cannot validate the currently authored Physics Material because the actual delivered normal force is not established by this calculation.

isaac_drive_mapping.prohibited_mapping: DYNAMIXEL Position_P_Gain and Position_D_Gain table values are dimensionless internal-controller coefficients and shall not be copied into PhysX SI stiffness/damping.
recommended_derivation_order: select exact runtime pipeline and current limit
derive a bounded motor torque envelope from exact-model manufacturer data
map torque through the exact linkage Jacobian and separately account for efficiency and thermal limits
obtain desired or identified closed-loop natural frequency and damping ratio
compute effective joint inertia from the verified mass model at a declared configuration
compute PhysX stiffness/damping with the local Gain Tuner 3.0.6 equations
validate command tracking, overshoot, saturation, effort, and contact force without changing unrelated parameters

collider_research.finding: Convex decomposition is not monotonically more accurate on the exact inward face; its right-side maximum inward crossing is worse than the single hull. Approximation choice therefore cannot be selected by approximation name alone.

task_local_acceptance_contract.required_geometry_domain: the swept Bottle500 contact band over the legal finger trajectory, not the whole visual mesh volume
mandatory_signed_metrics: no collider crossing to the wrong side of the authoritative CAD inward surface beyond numerical tolerance
maximum signed normal offset over the active contact band
contact-normal angular error relative to the authoritative CAD face
left/right symmetry after applying their distinct handed B-Reps and placements
minimum clearance to gripper bar, shell, carriage, and opposite finger over the legal q range
Bottle500 swept-volume overlap and tunneling margin
task_local_acceptance_contract.acceptance_rule: Predeclare a one-sided signed surface-error bound from independent input uncertainties; do not choose it from whether the bottle happened to be held.

local_metadata_evidence.supplier_finger_step: FreeCAD exposes ShapeMaterial/Material property names, but the probe contains no populated material value for the embedded v2 finger B-Reps

verified_isaac_semantics.binding_scope: physics material may bind to collider or a parent rigid body with resolution/strength determining the effective material
verified_isaac_semantics.contact_offset: distance envelope in which contact constraints begin
verified_isaac_semantics.rest_offset: effective separation at which shapes come to rest

missing_exact_physical_identity: supplier ALOHA finger-pad material and surface finish
project Bottle500 body material and surface finish
static friction, dynamic friction, and restitution for that exact pair
not_valid_substitutes: Trossen statement that fingers may be 3D printed
a friction value that makes a hold test pass
contact_material_research.minimum_measurement_if_official_pair_dat: controlled incline, pull, or tribometer test on the exact pad/bottle surfaces with normal load, direction, speed, temperature, and surface condition recorded
contact_material_research.simulation_policy: until calibrated, any numerical friction value must remain TEMPORARY_UNCALIBRATED and must not be described as sim-to-real validated

available_official_envelope: XM430-W350 and XM540-W270 voltage-conditioned stall/no-load points
operating temperature and over-temperature shutdown behavior
missing_for_continuous_claim: continuous torque-speed-current curve at declared ambient temperature
allowable duty cycle and winding/case thermal steady state
derating across voltage and ambient temperature
gripper linkage efficiency and friction under sustained clamp
continuous_actuator_research.strict_interpretation: Stall torque is a momentary endpoint and an 80 C shutdown threshold is protection, not an allowable continuous operating curve.
resolution_paths: obtain an exact-model ROBOTIS continuous-duty or thermal application curve
or run an approved real-hardware thermal test with current, voltage, speed, torque/load, ambient, case temperature, winding proxy, and duty cycle

fixed_model_inputs: same USD composition and collider profile
same mass, inertia, gravity, material, drive, initial state, and trajectory
one_variable_at_a_time_sequence: time step convergence at fixed high solver iterations: 60, 120, 240, 480, and if needed 960 Hz
position-iteration convergence at selected time step
velocity-iteration convergence at selected position iterations
metrics: joint pose and velocity trajectory error
signed normal and tangential impulse integrals
Bottle500 pose, velocity, angular velocity, support clearance, and hold drop
drive target error and saturation duration
numerical_error_budget_research.tolerance_derivation: Use V1/V2 analytic free-motion baselines and successive fine-grid differences to estimate integration/noise floors, then combine them with the independently derived geometry budget. Select the coarsest time step and lowest iteration counts satisfying all predeclared bounds.
numerical_error_budget_research.prohibited_method: Do not define the error budget after observing which setting makes a grasp pass.

blocker_disposition.reason: momentary manufacturer curves exist; continuous thermal/duty behavior does not
schema equations and linkage force mapping are solved; effective inertia, desired/identified response, efficiency, and continuous saturation remain
acceptance is a task-local signed geometry and swept-volume contract, not missing vendor data
exact pad and Bottle500 material/finish pair is unidentified and no exact official coefficient was found
solver/time-step accuracy is a numerical convergence problem, not a real-hardware parameter

recommended_next_actions.action: correct the gripper hardware-model source semantics in an isolated reviewed change: current_based_position at runtime, with pipeline-scoped Current_Limit values
implement the task-local signed collider certificate on the Bottle500 swept contact band and evaluate the existing CAD-derived compound candidate without promoting it
run the predeclared timestep and solver convergence matrix and generate the numerical error budget
derive force-drive candidates from effective inertia and an identified or declared closed-loop response; keep all candidates diagnostic until verified
recommended_next_actions.boundary: sim-to-real calibration still requires physical response/efficiency evidence

recommended_next_actions.action: identify exact finger-pad and Bottle500 surface materials from supplier/manufacturing records; if unavailable, prepare a controlled measurement sheet
request an exact-model continuous-duty curve from ROBOTIS or obtain authorization for a controlled thermal test
